Player labels & details

Klik baut pilih pemain yang kamu pengenin. Kolom bisa diisi nama atau anotasi terserah. Bisa digambar dan dikasi box interpretasi juga.

V Select L Line T Text

Your text appears above the player as you type and saves automatically. Labels belong to a track; review them after an ID change.

Adjust in percent of the player box. Positive moves right / down; 0 resets. Rings and your connections move together.

Connect your players

Choose pairs or click a sequence. Lines follow those players without changing your arrangement.

Click players in the video, or choose a player above and press Add selected player. Short gaps up to 0.6 seconds use the same track before and after the gap; dashed lines mark estimates. Longer gaps hide the line. Connections stay saved within their camera scene. The drawing toolbar Line tool creates a fixed drawing; use Start connecting for lines that follow players.

No custom connections in this camera scene.

If an ID changes: pause, choose the old track here, select the same player under their new ID in the video or player picker, then reattach. All lines for that endpoint follow the replacement from this time onward. Earlier playback is preserved. Undo reverses the correction.

Tactical patterns

Search observed player visits to a pitch zone. Review candidates in the video and save your own interpretation.

Configure zone & search

Left/top follow your four-corner calibration, not a team's attacking direction. Percentages are dimensionless, not meters. This zone is separate from drawings on the video.

Calibrate a wide view first. Searches cover only its camera scene; other scenes and unknown projections are skipped. Review alignment for drift. Missing players break visits. Observed time spans consecutive inside samples only; it is not exact total occupancy. No passes or possession are inferred.

No search yet. Results are temporary; save notes or export reviewed results to keep them.
